image_description: A large, mature common iguana (Iguana iguana) resting on the ground amidst dry leaves and green foliage. The iguana has a robust body with greyish-green coloration and distinct orange/reddish hues on its lower jaw and limbs. It features a prominent dorsal crest of spines running from the neck down the back. The head is large with visible scales, and the eye is clear. The tail extends towards the right, partially obscured by vegetation.
